## VoiceAI Connect provides Deutsche Telekom with an open, secure and flexible foundation for seamlessly integrating its mobile network with AI services, accelerating the introduction of new AI-powered capabilities as technologies and customer needs evolve


**Or Yehuda, Israel – October 19, 2026 – AudioCodes (NASDAQ: AUDC) Press Release**


AudioCodes, a leading vendor of advanced communications software, products and AI-powered solutions for the digital workplace and customer experience, today announced that Deutsche Telekom is leveraging AudioCodes VoiceAI Connect for its new Voice AI Notes Mobile service for small and medium-sized businesses.


Voice AI Notes Mobile automatically records, transcribes and summarizes business phone calls, helping employees spend less time on administrative tasks and more time focusing on customers and core business activities.


VoiceAI Connect provides the real-time connectivity and orchestration layer between any voice network and AI services. Its modular architecture and open APIs decouple voice connectivity from the choice of AI models and speech technologies, enabling organizations to adopt new AI capabilities as requirements and technology evolve while reducing the need to rework existing network and business application integrations. VoiceAI Connect leverages AudioCodes SBC technology to deliver robust, scalable connectivity across carrier and enterprise voice networks.


VoiceAI Connect can be deployed within organizations' own data centers or cloud environments, supporting sovereign AI services and control over where sensitive voice and AI workloads are processed. These deployment options help organizations address data residency, security, confidentiality and regulatory requirements while allowing them to retain flexibility in their choice of AI technologies. Deutsche Telekom's deployment within its T Cloud environment illustrates this approach.


Once integrated into the network, VoiceAI Connect can enable new use cases to be configured and introduced within weeks, including voice agents, Agent Assist, call summarization, real-time translation and automated follow-up actions. This flexibility helps service providers and enterprises expand voice AI adoption across customer engagement, employee productivity and business process automation. It also shortens time-to-market and creates opportunities to generate revenue sooner, with less dependence on lengthy traditional feature development cycles.


"AudioCodes has been a trusted technology partner of Deutsche Telekom for many years, supporting our business communications services with reliable voice and data connectivity," said Claudia Buhne, Vice President Portfolio/Business Communication & Collaboration at Deutsche Telekom Geschäftskunden GmbH. "VoiceAI Connect extends this collaboration into AI by seamlessly integrating and orchestrating our mobile network with Mistral AI services, while giving us the flexibility to bring new AI-powered capabilities to our customers quickly."


"For AI services involving business communications, innovation, flexibility and digital sovereignty need to go hand in hand," said Yehuda Herscovici, Vice President, Product at AudioCodes. "VoiceAI Connect is designed for this model, combining open integration across AI technologies with flexible deployment inside the service provider's controlled environment. Its deployment within Deutsche Telekom's T Cloud demonstrates how advanced Voice AI services can evolve rapidly while maintaining control over sensitive voice and AI workloads."


For more information about AudioCodes VoiceAI Connect, visit the[AudioCodes VoiceAI Connect website](https://voiceaiconnect.audiocodes.com/) .
